q: In the role-play method, learners:
options: listen to the teacher's continuous talk
act out situations or characters to understand a concept or problem
exp: Role play develops empathy, communication and understanding through enactment.

q: The best statement about teaching aids is that they:
options: are required only for weak students
should be used whether or not the topic needs them
supplement the teacher but cannot replace the teacher
exp: Aids support and make teaching effective; the teacher remains central.

q: Varying voice, gestures, movement and using pauses are components of the skill of:
exp: Stimulus variation sustains attention by changing the stimuli presented to learners.

q: In Mager's ABCD format for writing objectives, 'D' stands for:
exp: The ABCD elements are Audience, Behaviour, Condition and Degree.

q: A spiral curriculum, proposed by Bruner, means that:
options: each topic is taught only once
topics are removed after the first class
topics are revisited at increasing levels of complexity
exp: Concepts are repeatedly met at greater depth as learners grow.

q: Which of the following is a co-scholastic area?
exp: Co-scholastic areas include life skills, attitudes, values, sports and arts.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: In a test, 40 out of 50 students answered an item correctly. The difficulty index (p = R/N) of this item is:
exp: p = 40/50 = 0.80, so the item is easy.

q: A weighing scale always shows 2 kg more than the actual weight. The scale is:
exp: It is consistent (reliable) but does not give the true weight (not valid).

q: ADHD is mainly characterised by:
exp: Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder shows persistent inattention with hyperactivity/impulsivity.

q: A hypothesis is best defined as:
options: a tentative statement about the relation between variables, to be tested
exp: It is a testable proposition that guides the investigation.

q: Which of the following is an open-source learning management system (LMS)?
exp: Moodle is a widely used open-source LMS.

q: NEP 2020 set a target of Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education of:
exp: The aim is to raise GER to 50% by 2035.

q: Which of the following is an unethical practice for a teacher?
options: Favouring some students in marking because of personal relations
exp: Partiality violates fairness.

q: Which of the following is a common misconception of novice programmers?
options: Understanding that assignment overwrites the old value
Believing that a variable stores all values it has ever held
exp: A variable holds only its current value; novices often think it keeps history.

q: In Pavlov's experiment, the sound of the bell that initially caused no salivation is called the:
options: neutral stimulus which later becomes the conditioned stimulus
exp: The bell was neutral at first; after pairing with food it became the conditioned stimulus.

q: The heuristic method of teaching was advocated by:
exp: Armstrong wanted students to discover facts for themselves, as 'heurisko' means 'I find out'.

q: Which of the following is the most important criterion for selecting a teaching aid?
exp: An aid must help achieve the specific objective of the lesson.

q: The skill of 'set induction' refers to:
options: summarising at the end of a lesson
creating readiness among students at the start of a lesson
exp: Set induction prepares learners mentally for the new topic.

q: Which of the following is the best specific objective for a computer science lesson?
options: The teacher will explain number systems
The student will convert the decimal number 25 into binary correctly
The student will know everything about numbers
exp: It is specific, observable and measurable.

q: Which of the following is a difference between curriculum and syllabus?
options: Syllabus is narrower and lists topics for a subject, while curriculum includes all learning experiences
exp: Curriculum is broader and includes co-curricular experiences and methods.

q: 'Assessment for learning' differs from 'assessment of learning' in that it:
options: is used to guide and improve instruction during learning
is conducted only at the end
exp: Assessment for learning is formative, whereas assessment of learning is summative.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: In item analysis, the upper group had 18 correct answers and the lower group had 6 correct answers, each group having 20 students. The discrimination index is:
The test–retest method is used to estimate which characteristic of a test?
exp: Administering the same test twice and correlating scores gives the coefficient of stability (reliability).

q: Dysgraphia is a disorder related to:
exp: Dysgraphia affects handwriting and written expression.

q: The research method in which the investigator collects data from a large group through questionnaires or interviews is the:
exp: Survey research describes the existing conditions in a population.

q: Blended learning is:
options: a combination of face-to-face teaching and online learning
learning without a teacher or books
exp: It combines classroom and online modes.

q: NEP 2020 recommended renaming the Ministry of Human Resource Development as:
exp: The ministry was renamed accordingly.

q: Professional development of a teacher is best promoted by:
options: attending workshops, reading and reflecting on one's teaching
exp: Continuous learning keeps teaching effective.

q: Python is often chosen as a first language in schools because it:
options: cannot be used for real applications
exp: Simple syntax lets learners focus on problem-solving.

q: According to Piaget, children aged about 7 to 11 years are in the:
exp: Logical thinking about concrete objects, conservation and classification develop in the concrete operational stage.

q: The Dalton Plan of education was proposed by:
exp: Parkhurst's Dalton Plan lets pupils work at their own pace through assignments and contracts.

q: An epidiascope is used to:
options: project opaque objects such as pictures from books
exp: The epidiascope can project both opaque pictures and transparencies.

q: The skill of closure is mainly concerned with:
options: starting the lesson with a joke
consolidating the lesson at the end and linking it to the next
exp: Closure helps students retain the main points.

q: Testing the previous knowledge of students at the start of a lesson is part of which step?
exp: Previous knowledge is tested to link the new matter with what is already known.

q: The report 'Learning Without Burden' (1993) was chaired by:
exp: The Yash Pal Committee highlighted the need to reduce curriculum load.

q: A collection of a student's work over time that shows progress is called:
exp: Portfolio assessment documents learner growth through samples of work.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: A student has mental age 12 and chronological age 10. The intelligence quotient is:
Predictive validity is established by:
options: correlating test scores with later performance
exp: If scores predict future success, the test has predictive validity.
